cases.question: What evidence must the Atlas release review contain before approval?

sources.heading: Atlas release review evidence
sources.body: The Atlas release review must contain a passing migration rehearsal and an accessibility audit. A screenshot alone is insufficient.

sources.heading: Team travel

cases.question: According to the current Beacon retention policy, how many days are exports retained, and which policy is superseded?

sources.heading: Beacon retention policy archive
sources.body: Policy R1 required retaining exports for 90 days. It was superseded by R2.

sources.heading: Current Beacon retention policy R2
sources.body: Policy R2 is current and requires retaining exports for 14 days. R2 supersedes R1; the old 90-day limit must not be used.
